name: frontend
description: Frontend application with Node.js build and static server

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist && echo 'body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 0; padding: 20px; }' > dist/style.css
scripts.build:js: mkdir -p dist && echo 'console.log("Frontend app loaded");' > dist/app.js
